fra-bartolommeo: Leader Scott tells the life of Fra Bartolommeo — the Dominican friar who became a great Renaissance painter. His art, his faith, and his Florence come alive in these pages. A fine study of a noble artist-monk. Savonarola's friend painted Madonnas of heavenly sweetness in turbulent times.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-andrea-borrom: A 1913 entry on Andrea Borromeo — the Theatine missionary to Georgia. Nicholas Weber honors his daring. He carried the faith to the Caucasus. The mission tested his courage. An apostle of the eastern mountains. His letters describe the mountain tribes. His martyrdom crowned the mission.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-antonio-tebal: This 1913 reference article on Antonio Tebaldeo — the Ferrarese poet. Jeremiah Ford notes his elegant verse. His eclogues charmed the Este court. The entry preserves his modest fame. A poet of the Renaissance courts. His sonnets graced the courtly albums. His verse pleased the Mantuan court.
